entities.summary: Zohra Rasekh Kashanian was an Afghan doctor, women's rights activist and writer. She was the co-author of the report The Taliban's War on Women: A Health and Human Rights Crisis in Afghanistan and was a member of Global Watch Group (GWG), Physicians for Human Rights, and the United Nations Committee on the Elimination of Discrimination against Women.
